newsitem.title: UK: Jarvis spends 16.22 mln stg on hotels.
newsitem.headline: Jarvis spends 16.22 mln stg on hotels.

text.p: Jarvis Hotels Plc said on Monday it had acquired two hotels in England and one in Scotland for a cash sum of 16.22 million stg from administrative receiver Edward Klempka of Cooper & Lybrand in Leeds.
The hotels are the 90 bedroom Fairfield Manor Hotel in York, the 107 bedroom Grange Park Hotel in Hull and the 62 bedroom Learmonth Hotel in Edinburgh.
The administrative receivers to the hotels were appointed on December 27, 1996 and a new company, Croft Hotels (1996) Ltd was formed to allow the hotels to trade as normal.
Jarvis said the acquisitions closely followed its 13.5 million stg purchase of the Carnarvon Hotel in London on December 16 and bring the total number of hotels it owns and operates in Britain to 68.
